parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, small in size and rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow or temperature when rotated or lifted.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, similar to the first one.
parts.Functional_description: It controls either hot or cold water flow depending on the faucet design.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, a curved tubular part made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a base frame part of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the faucet to the sink or countertop.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another frame component of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing stability.
parts.Functional_description: It helps mount the faucet securely and maintain alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the final frame part of the faucet, made of stainless steel, forming the base structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides mechanical support and connects the faucet assembly to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during faucet operation.
